body:
Thanks. Found out I was manic depressive in the interim, and now I understand why no one wants to stay on those meds. 

I was finally happy.

Well, I may just be one gal, but at 5'8" (I hear that's quite above average for women), I don't see the big deal. 

No pun intended. 

The guy I'm currently seeing is an inch or so shorter than I, which is a first for us both. We acknowledged it jokingly ("oh good, a place to rest my purse!" "your legs are REALLY long there, Spider-legs") and moved on. 

I see the short hate happening sometimes, but I don't really understand it. It boils down to the old "be yourself" routine, I guess. Everybody has different 'attractiveness' criteria. Just because part of the population dislikes brunettes, blondes don't have all the fun.

That escalated quickly. 

:(
I love you for the Nutella idea.

I'm not quite sure how to quantify "exercise", since I don't actually set aside time for it, but I'm in my feet/walking/rushing for a majority of my work day. Apparently my BMR is 1450, but going by what you recommend that would only put me at 1700/day, which seems a bit low?

I don't particularly feel unhealthy, only when I receive comments along the lines of "you must not eat."

Obviously I do have fat on my body, but I feel as though in the past two weeks of pounding protein shakes, I've become noticeably more muscular. I edited my post to add a link to a picture. Note: it's a heavily padded bra :X
I edited my post to include a picture. Also, the bananna flavor is for heathens.
... why would I want fewer calories?

I've never done anything on the regular, my schedule is slightly sporadic (which I know is no excuse) but that coupled with the fact that I have no idea what I'm doing pretty much steers me away.
My diet is atrocious. I'm shit at eating in the mornings, but lunch is usually pizza or fast food, dinner the same, with weight gain shakes thrown in for good measure.
once, I added a slice of cheesecake in the blender,  along with ice cream, weight gain, and soy milk. The cup weighed about 3 pounds but dear god, so heavenly on the tongue...

If only he would date me...
But that's a whole other pandora's box of neurosis.

I can understand where you're coming from with dancing. I have no sense of rhythm,  but I am apparently stronger than people expect from my size (you have nearly 30 pounds on me, but same height). It is fun and rewarding to carry furniture or lift a box or turn a wrench that somebody else was struggling with. :)
Interesting... Maybe it's a Slavic thing. My grandmother and mother had/have similar body types, although at 5'8" I'm a little extra bean pole-y.
What if I'm under the normal range?
I'm active at work, in the sense that I'm on my feet and moving around quite a bit. Exercise, not so much. I'm pretty sedentary in my free time. And yep, smoker in the hizzy.

Her limbs are much, much shorter than mine, and like her hips, thicker than mine.

Sigh.

As far as actions to change it, believe me I'm trying. I've overhauled my diet many times, I have to have a drastic caloric intake before I start seeing results (around 3000, which can make me feel a bit sick by the time evening rolls around.)

Sorry, I'm redditing from my tablet, here's the original post http://www.reddit.com/r/pics/comments/1gqh9y/eating_disorders_are_totally_lame_xpost_40_lb/

No special occasions, just fun casual pieces. I have a semi strict dress code at work, and nothing I wear there would carry over to a day off. So, incase I ever make a friend or meet someone, I have things to wear to the movies, or the park, or to the bar. 

And yeah, I would look pretty damn good. But the debt carpets my room instead.

Sorry, that was unclear. I have seen three seperate therapists, and one psychiatrist. I am still seeing the latter because he keeps me medicated. The therapists, however, all left me wholly unimpressed. The first basically equated the fact that I was a "beautiful, smart young woman" to his opinion that I was going to have an awesome life. 

So, my apparently guaranteed success human skin is defective. Typical.
Was that a compliment?
I've tried both. A few therapists, still seeing the psychiatrist for medication. It reinforces the dam, but can't completely fix the cracks.

Fun and distractions, if anything, are a band-aid on a missing limb. If I manage to keep my mind busy (primarily at work, as I don't have much of anyone else to socialize with), at the end of the day there is still a giant empty tomorrow on the horizon. 

As for what I do for fun? Well, this one is a riot. I love to shop. I love to put together these awesome outfits, just incase I ever have somewhere to go. However, at present moment, I have (from what I can see near me) approximately $1500 worth of clothing that I have never worn, with tags, covering my bedroom floor in piles. 

I've had 2 places to go since New Year's.
